scope: Android prototype UI, immersive overlay, localized curated settings; no physical phone or camera operations
changed_contracts: No top message banner; Toast feedback and separate export progress row
Single-line RES/FPS/FOV/EV/COLOR capsules, actual settings values
Fullscreen reuses preview container with right parameter rail and bottom mode/shutter controls; window orientation reflow
Fill/crop and complete-frame modes remain consistent across navigation
Chinese names for actual network and identifier keys; capability/status/action and alias filtering preserves raw JSON
Known identifiers and telemetry show no misleading edit action; clock synchronization uses one row

avd.scope: headless Android AVD only; no physical phone or camera access
workflows: Real touch fullscreen -> landscape -> portrait -> exit -> settings; modes/shutter/parameters reachable

limitations: No physical phone or live camera acceptance in this run
Fill mode crops the preview edges; complete mode preserves source framing
No exact recording duration is fabricated from app elapsed time
No camera voice setter, EIS replacement, native execution or minute-prebuffer backend deployed

historical_avd_runs.note: Runs01-03 contain older builds, setup failures and the parameter clipping regression; none counts as final acceptance
